topic_ko: 도서 기부 행사 참여 독려 안내문

passage: Dear Residents, I am Trixie Mitchell, the director of the Riverside Community Center.
I am pleased inviting you to a book donation drive this season.
We are collecting used books to support our reading programs for children and teenagers.
By donating books, you can help young readers discover the joy of reading.
Any books in good condition are gladly accepted, including novels, poetry, and non-fiction.
You can bring your books to our community center during our operating hours.
We would be grateful if you could join this meaningful event.
grammar.explanation_ko: ① 'be pleased + to부정사(~하게 되어 기쁘다)' 구조이므로 'to invite'가 와야 한다. 동명사 'inviting'은 이 구문에 맞지 않아 비문이다. ①이 정답.
grammar.distractor_ko: ②목적의 to부정사 to support, ③help + 목적어 + 원형부정사 discover, ④부대 상황의 분사 including(~을 포함하여), ⑤가정법 if절의 could join은 모두 옳다.

passage: Dear Residents, I am Trixie Mitchell, the director of the Riverside Community Center.
I am pleased to invite you to a book donation drive this season.
We are collecting used books to support our reading programs for children and teenagers.
By donating books, you can help young readers discover the boredom of reading.
Any books in good condition are gladly accepted, including novels, poetry, and non-fiction.
You can bring your books to our community center during our operating hours.
We would be grateful if you could join this meaningful event.
vocab.explanation_ko: ③ 책 기부는 어린 독자가 읽기의 '기쁨(joy)'을 발견하도록 돕는다는 문맥이므로 '지루함(boredom)'은 정반대 의미라 부적절하다. joy로 고쳐야 한다. ③이 정답.
vocab.distractor_ko: ①초대하다(invite), ②후원하다(support), ④상태가 좋은(good), ⑤뜻깊은(meaningful)은 문맥에 적절하다.

order.given: Dear Residents, I am Trixie Mitchell, the director of the Riverside Community Center, and I am pleased to invite you to a book donation drive.

blocks.A: Any books in good condition are gladly accepted, including novels, poetry, and non-fiction books, and you can bring them to our center during operating hours.
blocks.B: We are collecting used books to support our reading programs for children and teenagers, so that young readers can discover the joy of reading.
blocks.C: We would be truly grateful if you could join this meaningful event and share the gift of reading with our community.

order.explanation_ko: 초대(주어진 글) 뒤에 행사의 목적과 취지를 설명하는 (B), 기부 방법(어떤 책을 어디에) 안내인 (A), 끝으로 참여를 정중히 부탁하는 (C)가 자연스럽다. (B)-(A)-(C).
order.distractor_ko: (C)의 마무리 인사는 마지막이라야 하고, (A)의 구체적 안내는 행사 취지 설명(B) 뒤에 와야 한다.

insert.insert_sentence: Any books in good condition are gladly accepted, including novels, poetry, and non-fiction books.

passage_marked.text: I am pleased to invite you to a book donation drive at the Riverside Community Center.
We are collecting used books to support our reading programs for children and teenagers.
By donating books, you can help young readers discover the joy of reading.
You can bring your books to our community center during our operating hours.
We would be grateful if you could join this meaningful event.

insert.explanation_ko: 주어진 문장은 '어떤 책을' 받는지(상태 좋은 모든 책) 안내하는 내용이다. 기부의 취지(③ 문장) 뒤이자 '어디로 가져오면 되는지'(④ 뒤 문장)를 안내하기 직전인 ④에 와야 자연스럽다. ④가 정답.
insert.distractor_ko: 받을 책의 종류를 먼저 알려야 가져오는 장소·시간 안내가 이어지므로, 장소 안내 문장 앞(④)이 적절하다.

passage: Trixie Mitchell, the director of the Riverside Community Center, is hosting a book donation drive.
The center is collecting used books to support reading programs for children and teenagers.
By donating books, residents can help young readers discover the joy of reading.
Any books in good condition, such as novels, poetry, and non-fiction, are gladly accepted.
Residents can bring their books to the center during its operating hours.
The director would be grateful if residents joined this meaningful event.
summary.summary_template: The director invites residents to __(A)__ used books so that the center can __(B)__ its reading programs for young people.
summary.explanation_ko: 주민들에게 쓰던 책을 (A)donate(기부)하라고 권유하여 센터가 청소년 독서 프로그램을 (B)support(후원)할 수 있게 하려는 글이다. ③.
summary.distractor_ko: (A)는 donate, (B)는 support여야 한다. sell/borrow/discard나 cancel/limit은 안내문의 취지와 맞지 않는다.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 저는 여러분을 도서 기부 행사에 초대하게 되어 기쁩니다.
writing.answer: I am pleased to invite you to a book donation drive.
writing.explanation_ko: be pleased to invite(초대하게 되어 기쁘다) + 목적어 you + to a book donation drive.

writing.question: 다음 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 책을 기부함으로써, 여러분은 어린 독자들이 읽기의 기쁨을 발견하도록 도울 수 있습니다.
conditions: By로 시작하는 동명사 구문을 사용할 것
help + 목적어 + 동사원형 구조를 사용할 것
writing.answer: By donating books, you can help young readers discover the joy of reading.
writing.explanation_ko: By + 동명사 donating + help young readers + 원형부정사 discover.

writing.question: 다음 글을 읽고, 흐름상 빈칸에 들어갈 한 단어를 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오.
writing.context: We are collecting used books to ___________ our reading programs for children and teenagers.
writing.explanation_ko: 독서 프로그램을 '후원하기(support)' 위해 책을 모은다는 흐름이다.

writing.question: 다음 밑줄 친 문장을 우리말로 해석하시오.
writing.en_prompt: We would be grateful if you could join this meaningful event.
writing.answer: 여러분이 이 뜻깊은 행사에 참여해 주신다면 저희는 감사할 것입니다.
writing.explanation_ko: would be grateful(감사할 것이다), if you could join(참여해 준다면), meaningful event(뜻깊은 행사).
